review:
Wonders of Aztec is a tumbling Pragmatic Play slot built around reel multipliers. Bomb symbols can land on any spin or tumble and either add a 2x multiplier to their reel or, on a win, double that reel's current value up to 128x. Super bombs on a winning spin upgrade every reel at once, and when the tumble sequence ends the win is boosted by the sum of all reel multipliers.

Four, five or six scatters award 10, 20 or 30 free spins, and the reel multipliers no longer reset between spins, so they can keep building. Retriggers add five spins. A super scatter in the trigger first drops random bombs to raise the starting multipliers. Published RTP is 96.55%. It suits players who like building multipliers.
